questions.question:
Identify the correct form of the sentence using the subjunctive mood to express a hypothetical condition.

If the committee had been more flexible, the project ________ on time.

Which sentence correctly uses an elliptical construction to avoid unnecessary repetition?

After discussing the proposal, the board decided to postpone the meeting, while the management team insisted on continuing the discussion.
options: After discussing the proposal, the board decided to postpone the meeting, whereas the management team insisted on continuing the discussion.
After discussing the proposal, the board decided to postpone the meeting, while the management team insisted on continuing the discussion.
After discussing the proposal, the board decided to postpone the meeting, and the management team insisted on continuing the discussion.
After discussing the proposal, the board decided to postpone the meeting, so the management team insisted on continuing the discussion.
questions.answer: After discussing the proposal, the board decided to postpone the meeting, while the management team insisted on continuing the discussion.

questions.question:
Select the correct form of the sentence that uses a cleft sentence structure to emphasize the location.

It was in the old library that the historian discovered the rare manuscript.
options: It was in the old library that the historian discovered the rare manuscript.
The historian discovered the rare manuscript in the old library.
The old library was where the historian discovered the rare manuscript.
The rare manuscript was discovered by the historian in the old library.
questions.answer: It was in the old library that the historian discovered the rare manuscript.
